text: This is what my mom also goes through every time she comes, although with a positive outcome but still with the same unpleasant experience of being held few hours. They dont really interrogate them (she doesn't speak english) they just let them sit alone for hours until they check who they are visiting. They have not asked my mother a single question besides who is she visiting. But for that she had to wait for hours. The last 1.5 year though she had been passing without any problem and I thought that because of war the delusion of people voluntarily coming to live in Israel illegally had passed, but i was wrong. I am sorry this happened, border control is really absurd. Last week they allowed a known neonazi antisemitic popular person to enter but our parents are the problem 🤷🏻‍♀️
